docs.title: 💹 Trade Unrealized P/L
docs.text:
Request: the best and worst unrealized P/L each open order has reached since a start time (TradeUnrealizedPLData) — how far every live position ran into profit and into loss.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account.tradeUnrealizedPl(request) (from @metarpc/nodemt4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.TradeStats
  • Proto definition: TradeUnrealizedPL (defined in mt4-term-api-trade-stats.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.TradeStats
  • Method: TradeUnrealizedPL(TradeUnrealizedPLRequest) → TradeUnrealizedPLReply
  • Low-level client (generated): TradeStatsClient.tradeUnrealizedPL(request, metadata, opts, cb) (note the upper-case PL)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. For each currently-open order, the maximum and minimum floating P/L it reached since from — the run-up and the drawdown of the live trade.
  • Why you need it. Trade-management analytics: how much profit was given back, how deep each position dipped (MAE/MFE).
  • Sanity check. The list has one entry per open order; it is empty when nothing is open.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
Use it to study maximum adverse / favorable excursion of open orders. Read-only.

Prefer plain values? MT4Service.getTradeUnrealizedPl(from) returns a plain array (each entry already a JS object).

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT4Account, TradeStatsPb, toTimestamp } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

class MT4Account {
  // Best/worst unrealized P/L per open order. Returns the raw TradeUnrealizedPLData; throws MrpcError on failure.
  tradeUnrealizedPl(req: any /* TradeUnrealizedPLRequest */): Promise<any /* TradeUnrealizedPLData */>;
}

Request message:

TradeUnrealizedPLRequest {
  string from     = 1;  // since when to track extrema, server time
  string from_utc = 2;  // since when, UTC (prefer this)
}

Reply message: TradeUnrealizedPLReply { oneof response { TradeUnrealizedPLData data = 1; Error error = 2; } }.

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Parameter Type Description req TradeUnrealizedPLRequest setFromUtc(isoUtcString) — the instant from which extrema are measured (UTC).

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — TradeUnrealizedPLData
docs.text:
getExtremaList() → TradeUnrealizedExtremaData[]. Each entry:

JS accessor Type Description getTicket() number The open order's ticket. getSymbol() string The order's symbol. getMaxUnrealizedPl() number Highest floating P/L reached (run-up / MFE). getMinUnrealizedPl() number Lowest floating P/L reached (drawdown / MAE). getMaxUnrealizedTime() / ...TimeUtc() Timestamp When the max was reached (server / UTC). getMinUnrealizedTime() / ...TimeUtc() Timestamp When the min was reached (server / UTC).

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Open orders only — closed orders are in ordersHistory; their stats are in tradeStats.
  • Method name casing: the generated client method is tradeUnrealizedPL (upper-case PL); the SDK wrapper is tradeUnrealizedPl.
  • Errors are exceptions: rejects with MrpcError / the gRPC error.

docs.title: 1) Run-up and drawdown per open order
docs.text:
import { MT4Account, TradeStatsPb, toTimestamp } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

const req = new TradeStatsPb.TradeUnrealizedPLRequest();
req.setFromUtc(new Date(Date.now() - 24 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString());   // last 24h
const d = await account.tradeUnrealizedPl(req);

for (const e of d.getExtremaList()) {
  console.log(`#${e.getTicket()} ${e.getSymbol()}  best +${e.getMaxUnrealizedPl().toFixed(2)}  worst ${e.getMinUnrealizedPl().toFixed(2)}`);
}

docs.title: 2) Flag positions that gave back a lot of profit
docs.text:
for (const e of d.getExtremaList()) {
  const givenBack = e.getMaxUnrealizedPl();
  if (givenBack > 50) console.log(`⚠️ #${e.getTicket()} ran +${givenBack.toFixed(2)} — consider a trailing stop`);
}

docs.title: 📋 Opened Orders
docs.text:
Request: every open market order and pending order on the account (OpenedOrdersData), with full detail per order.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account.openedOrders(request?) (from @metarpc/nodemt4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Proto definition: OpenedOrders (defined in mt4-term-api-account-helper.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Method: OpenedOrders(OpenedOrdersRequest) → OpenedOrdersReply
  • Low-level client (generated): AccountHelperClient.openedOrders(request, metadata, opts, cb)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. The live book: all open market orders (types BUY/SELL) and pending orders (LIMIT/STOP).
  • Why you need it. Show open trades, sum floating P/L, find an order by symbol or magic, decide what to close.
  • Sanity check. getOrderInfosList().length is how many are open; 0 means flat.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
The one call for "what do I have open right now?". Read-only.

Prefer plain values? MT4Service.openedOrders() returns typed OrderInfo[]; positions() / pendingOrders() pre-filter by type.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT4Account, AccountHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

class MT4Account {
  // All open + pending orders. Returns the raw OpenedOrdersData; throws MrpcError on failure.
  openedOrders(req?: any /* OpenedOrdersRequest */): Promise<any /* OpenedOrdersData */>;
}

Request message:

OpenedOrdersRequest {
  EnumOpenedOrderSortType sort_type = 1;  // optional ordering (default open-time asc)
}

Reply message: OpenedOrdersReply { oneof response { OpenedOrdersData data = 1; Error error = 2; } }.

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Parameter Type Description req OpenedOrdersRequest (optional) Omit for the default. Set ordering with setSortType(EnumOpenedOrderSortType).

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — OpenedOrdersData
docs.text:
getOrderInfosList() → OpenedOrderInfo[]. Each order:

JS accessor Type Description getTicket() number Order ticket (unique id). getSymbol() string Symbol. getOrderType() number (enum) OpenedOrderType — 0 BUY · 1 SELL · 2 BUY_LIMIT · 3 SELL_LIMIT · 4 BUY_STOP · 5 SELL_STOP · 6 BALANCE · 7 CREDIT. See Enum fields below. getLots() number Volume in lots. getOpenPrice() number Entry price. getOpenTime() / getOpenTimeUtc() Timestamp Open time (server / UTC). getStopLoss() / getTakeProfit() number SL / TP prices (0 = none). getProfit() number Current floating P/L. getSwap() number Accrued swap. getCommision() number Commission (sic — proto spelling). getComment() string Order comment. getMagicNumber() number EA magic number. getExpirationTime() / getExpirationTimeUtc() Timestamp Pending-order expiry (server / UTC). getAccountLogin() number Owning account login.

docs.title: Input — setSortType() → EnumOpenedOrderSortType
docs.text:
enum EnumOpenedOrderSortType {
  SORT_BY_OPEN_TIME_ASC        = 0;  // oldest open first
  SORT_BY_OPEN_TIME_DESC       = 1;  // newest open first (default)
  SORT_BY_ORDER_TICKET_ID_ASC  = 2;  // lowest ticket first
  SORT_BY_ORDER_TICKET_ID_DESC = 3;  // highest ticket first
}

docs.title: Result — getOrderType() → OpenedOrderType
docs.text:
enum OpenedOrderType {
  OO_OP_BUY       = 0;  // market buy
  OO_OP_SELL      = 1;  // market sell
  OO_OP_BUYLIMIT  = 2;  // pending buy limit
  OO_OP_SELLLIMIT = 3;  // pending sell limit
  OO_OP_BUYSTOP   = 4;  // pending buy stop
  OO_OP_SELLSTOP  = 5;  // pending sell stop
  OO_OP_BALANCE   = 6;  // balance operation (deposit/withdrawal)
  OO_OP_CREDIT    = 7;  // credit operation
}

💡 Enum usage note: enums are namespace objects on AccountHelperPb. Compare against the full constant, e.g. o.getOrderType() === AccountHelperPb.OpenedOrderType.OO_OP_BUY. Types 6/7 are non-trade ledger entries — filter them out when you only want real orders.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Orders, not positions. Types 0/1 are market orders ("positions" in the friendly layers), 2–5 are pending.
  • Filter yourself by getOrderType() / getSymbol() / getMagicNumber(), or let MT4Service.positions(magic?) do it.
  • Errors are exceptions: rejects with MrpcError / the gRPC error.

docs.title: 1) List everything open
docs.text:
import { MT4Account } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

const account = new MT4Account('mt4.mrpc.pro', 443);
await account.connect({ user: 500000, password: 'password', server: 'TeleTrade-Demo' });

const data = await account.openedOrders();
for (const o of data.getOrderInfosList()) {
  console.log(`#${o.getTicket()} ${o.getSymbol()} type ${o.getOrderType()} lots ${o.getLots()} @ ${o.getOpenPrice()}  P/L ${o.getProfit().toFixed(2)}`);
}

docs.title: 2) Sum floating P/L of market orders
docs.text:
const data = await account.openedOrders();
const floating = data.getOrderInfosList()
  .filter((o: any) => o.getOrderType() === 0 || o.getOrderType() === 1)
  .reduce((s: number, o: any) => s + o.getProfit(), 0);
console.log('floating P/L:', floating.toFixed(2));

import { AccountHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

const req = new AccountHelperPb.OpenedOrdersRequest();

docs.title: 🎫 Opened Orders — Tickets
docs.text:
Request: just the ticket numbers of all open and pending orders (OpenedOrdersTicketsData) — the lightest "what's open?" call.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account.openedOrdersTickets(request?) (from @metarpc/nodemt4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Proto definition: OpenedOrdersTickets (defined in mt4-term-api-account-helper.proto)

  • Low-level client (generated): AccountHelperClient.openedOrdersTickets(request, metadata, opts, cb)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. An array of ticket numbers — no order detail.
  • Why you need it. Cheap polling for "did anything open/close?", reconciling against your own records, or counting open orders.
  • Sanity check. An empty array means nothing is open.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
Use it when you only need the tickets (not the full OpenedOrders payload) — e.g. a tight polling loop. Read-only.

Prefer plain values? MT4Service.openedOrdersTickets() returns number[].

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT4Account, AccountHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

class MT4Account {
  // The ticket numbers of all open/pending orders. Returns OpenedOrdersTicketsData; throws MrpcError on failure.
  openedOrdersTickets(req?: any /* OpenedOrdersTicketsRequest */): Promise<any /* OpenedOrdersTicketsData */>;

Request message: OpenedOrdersTicketsRequest {} (empty — the argument is optional)

Reply message: OpenedOrdersTicketsReply { oneof response { OpenedOrdersTicketsData data = 1; Error error = 2; } }.

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Parameter Type Description req OpenedOrdersTicketsRequest (optional) Empty request; omit it.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — OpenedOrdersTicketsData

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Lighter than openedOrders — use it for frequent polling; fetch full detail only when a ticket set changes.
  • No type split — the array mixes market and pending tickets; to tell them apart, read OpenedOrders.
  • Errors are exceptions: rejects with MrpcError / the gRPC error.

docs.title: 1) Count and list open tickets
docs.text:
const t = await account.openedOrdersTickets();
console.log(`${t.getTicketsList().length} open:`, t.getTicketsList());

docs.title: 2) Detect a change between polls
docs.text:
let prev = new Set<number>();
setInterval(async () => {
  const now = new Set((await account.openedOrdersTickets()).getTicketsList());
  const opened = [...now].filter((x) => !prev.has(x));
  const closed = [...prev].filter((x) => !now.has(x));
  if (opened.length) console.log('opened:', opened);
  if (closed.length) console.log('closed:', closed);
  prev = now;
}, 2000);

docs.title: 🗂️ Orders History
docs.text:
Request: closed orders in a time window (OrdersHistoryData) — sortable and paginated. The record of what already traded.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account.ordersHistory(request) (from @metarpc/nodemt4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Proto definition: OrdersHistory (defined in mt4-term-api-account-helper.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Method: OrdersHistory(OrdersHistoryRequest) → OrdersHistoryReply
  • Low-level client (generated): AccountHelperClient.ordersHistory(request, metadata, opts, cb)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. Closed orders between two times, with sort order and paging.
  • Why you need it. P/L reports, trade journals, reconciling fills. Closed orders carry a close time and close price that open orders don't.
  • Sanity check. getTotalCount() is the full match count; getOrdersInfoList() is the current page.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
The call for "what closed in this period?". Read-only.

Prefer plain values? MT4Service.ordersHistory(from, to, opts?) takes plain dates and returns { totalCount, orders: OrderInfo[] }.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT4Account, AccountHelperPb, toTimestamp } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

class MT4Account {
  // Closed orders over a window. Returns the raw OrdersHistoryData; throws MrpcError on failure.
  ordersHistory(req: any /* OrdersHistoryRequest */): Promise<any /* OrdersHistoryData */>;
}

Request message:

OrdersHistoryRequest {
  EnumOrderHistorySortType input_sort_mode = 1;  // ordering (default close-time desc)
  google.protobuf.Timestamp input_from     = 2;  // window start, broker server time
  google.protobuf.Timestamp input_to       = 3;  // window end,   broker server time
  int32 page_number    = 4;                       // optional paging
  int32 items_per_page = 5;
}

Reply message: OrdersHistoryReply { oneof response { OrdersHistoryData data = 1; Error error = 2; } }.

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Setter Type Description setInputSortMode(e) EnumOrderHistorySortType Ordering (default HISTORY_SORT_BY_CLOSE_TIME_DESC = 3). setInputFrom(ts) / setInputTo(ts) Timestamp Window bounds, broker server time — build with MT4Account.serverDate(utc, shiftMin). setPageNumber(n) / setItemsPerPage(n) number Optional pagination.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — OrdersHistoryData
docs.text:
JS accessor Type Description getTotalCount() number Total matching orders (across all pages). getOrdersInfoList() HistoryOrderInfo[] The current page of closed orders. getNextPageToken() string Cursor for the next page (when paginating).

Each HistoryOrderInfo has the same fields as OpenedOrderInfo plus:

JS accessor Type Description getCloseTime() / getCloseTimeUtc() Timestamp When the order closed (server / UTC). getClosePrice() number Closing price.

Each row's getOrderType() is AccountHelperPb.OpenedOrderType (0 BUY … 5 SELL_STOP, 6 BALANCE, 7 CREDIT) — the full table is on OpenedOrders.

docs.title: 🔢 Enum field — setInputSortMode() → EnumOrderHistorySortType
docs.text:
enum EnumOrderHistorySortType {
  HISTORY_SORT_BY_OPEN_TIME_ASC        = 0;  // oldest open first
  HISTORY_SORT_BY_OPEN_TIME_DESC       = 1;  // newest open first
  HISTORY_SORT_BY_CLOSE_TIME_ASC       = 2;  // oldest close first
  HISTORY_SORT_BY_CLOSE_TIME_DESC      = 3;  // newest close first (default)
  HISTORY_SORT_BY_ORDER_TICKET_ID_ASC  = 4;  // lowest ticket first
  HISTORY_SORT_BY_ORDER_TICKET_ID_DESC = 5;  // highest ticket first
}

Compare/assign against the full constant, e.g. req.setInputSortMode(AccountHelperPb.EnumOrderHistorySortType.HISTORY_SORT_BY_CLOSE_TIME_DESC).

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Server-time window. from/to are broker time. From UTC: const srv = MT4Account.serverDate(utcDate, shiftMin) where shiftMin = accountSummary().getUtcServerTimeShiftMinutes(). The friendly MT4Service.ordersHistory(from, to) takes plain dates.
  • Default sort is newest-closed first (3).
  • Paginate large windows with setItemsPerPage + setPageNumber; getTotalCount() sizes the result.
  • Errors are exceptions: rejects with MrpcError / the gRPC error (this call uses a longer deadline internally).

docs.title: 1) Last 7 days, newest first
docs.text:
import { MT4Account, AccountHelperPb, toTimestamp } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

const req = new AccountHelperPb.OrdersHistoryRequest();
req.setInputSortMode(AccountHelperPb.EnumOrderHistorySortType.HISTORY_SORT_BY_CLOSE_TIME_DESC);
req.setInputFrom(toTimestamp(new Date(Date.now() - 7 * 864e5)));
req.setInputTo(toTimestamp(new Date()));

const h = await account.ordersHistory(req);
console.log(`${h.getTotalCount()} closed orders`);
for (const o of h.getOrdersInfoList()) {
  console.log(`#${o.getTicket()} ${o.getSymbol()} P/L ${o.getProfit().toFixed(2)} closed @ ${o.getClosePrice()}`);
}

docs.title: 2) Net profit of the window
docs.text:
const net = h.getOrdersInfoList().reduce((s: number, o: any) => s + o.getProfit() + o.getSwap() + o.getCommision(), 0);
console.log('net P/L:', net.toFixed(2));

docs.title: 3) Page through a large history
docs.text:
const req = new AccountHelperPb.OrdersHistoryRequest();
req.setInputFrom(toTimestamp(new Date(Date.now() - 365 * 864e5)));
req.setInputTo(toTimestamp(new Date()));
req.setItemsPerPage(100);
req.setPageNumber(0);
const first = await account.ordersHistory(req);
console.log(`page 0 of ~${Math.ceil(first.getTotalCount() / 100)}  (${first.getOrdersInfoList().length} rows)`);

docs.text:

  • TradeStats — aggregated statistics over the same kind of window.
  • Friendly layer: MT4Service.ordersHistory(from, to) → { totalCount, orders }.

docs.title: MT4Account · Orders & History — Overview
docs.text:
The account's open orders (market + pending), their ticket numbers, and the closed-order history over a window. On MT4 everything is an order with a ticket — there are no positions and no netting.

These methods are read-only and live on mt4_term_api.AccountHelper. Each resolves with the raw *Data (read fields with getXxx()), or rejects with MrpcError.

docs.title: 📁 What lives here
docs.text:
• OpenedOrders — every open market order and pending order, with full details (symbol, type, lots, price, SL/TP, profit, swap, …).
  • OpenedOrdersTickets — just the ticket numbers of the open/pending orders (lighter than the full list).
  • OrdersHistory — closed orders in a time window, paginated and sortable.

docs.title: 🧭 Plain English
docs.text:
• OpenedOrders → the full picture of what's live right now.
  • OpenedOrdersTickets → a cheap "what's open?" when you only need the tickets.
  • OrdersHistory → what already closed, over a date range.

MT4 order types (shared with OrderSendOperationType): 0 BUY · 1 SELL · 2 BUY_LIMIT · 3 SELL_LIMIT · 4 BUY_STOP · 5 SELL_STOP. The friendly layers call types 0/1 positions and 2–5 pending orders.

docs.title: Quick choose
docs.text: If you need… Use Returns Full detail of every open/pending order openedOrders OpenedOrdersData Only the open/pending ticket numbers openedOrdersTickets OpenedOrdersTicketsData Closed orders over a date range (paginated) ordersHistory OrdersHistoryData

docs.title: ❌ Cross-refs & gotchas
docs.text:
• No positions on MT4. openedOrders returns orders; the friendly MT4Service.positions() simply filters it to types 0/1.
  • History windows are server time. ordersHistory takes from/to in broker server time — build them with MT4Account.serverDate(utc, shiftMin); the friendly MT4Service.ordersHistory(from, to) takes plain dates.
  • Pagination. ordersHistory supports setPageNumber / setItemsPerPage; getTotalCount() is the full match count, getNextPageToken() the cursor.
  • Open-order analytics (run-up / drawdown per order) live in TradeUnrealizedPL.

docs.title: 🟢 Minimal snippets
docs.text:
// Every open + pending order
const data = await account.openedOrders();
for (const o of data.getOrderInfosList()) {
  console.log(`#${o.getTicket()} ${o.getSymbol()} type ${o.getOrderType()} lots ${o.getLots()} P/L ${o.getProfit().toFixed(2)}`);
}

// Just the ticket numbers
const t = await account.openedOrdersTickets();
console.log('open tickets:', t.getTicketsList());

// Closed orders of the last 7 days, newest first
import { AccountHelperPb, toTimestamp } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

const req = new AccountHelperPb.OrdersHistoryRequest();
req.setInputSortMode(AccountHelperPb.EnumOrderHistorySortType.HISTORY_SORT_BY_CLOSE_TIME_DESC); // 3
req.setInputFrom(toTimestamp(new Date(Date.now() - 7 * 864e5)));
req.setInputTo(toTimestamp(new Date()));
const hist = await account.ordersHistory(req);
console.log(`${hist.getTotalCount()} closed orders`);

docs.title: 💱 Quote
docs.text:
Request: the latest tick (QuoteData) of one symbol — bid, ask, high, low and time. The price source to trade from.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account.quote(request) (from @metarpc/nodemt4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Proto definition: Quote (defined in mt4-term-api-market-info.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.MarketInfo

  • Low-level client (generated): MarketInfoClient.quote(request, metadata, opts, cb)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. A one-shot latest tick for a symbol.
  • Why you need it. Price a market order, compute spread, show a live rate.
  • Sanity check. getBid() > 0 && getAsk() > 0 means the symbol is selected and synchronized.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT4Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

class MT4Account {
  // Latest tick for one symbol. Returns the raw QuoteData; throws MrpcError on failure.
  quote(req: any /* QuoteRequest */): Promise<any /* QuoteData */>;
}

Request message: QuoteRequest { string symbol = 1; } · Reply: QuoteReply { oneof { QuoteData data; Error error; } }.

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Setter Type Description setSymbol(s) string The symbol to price.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — QuoteData
docs.text: JS accessor Type Description getSymbol() string The symbol. getBid() number Best bid. getAsk() number Best ask. getHigh() number Session high. getLow() number Session low. getDateTime() Timestamp Tick time, broker server time (.getSeconds()). getDateTimeUtc() Timestamp The same moment in UTC.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Spread = getAsk() - getBid() (price units); divide by the pip size for pips.
  • bid=ask=0? The symbol isn't selected/synchronized — SymbolSelect then retry, or MT4Service.ensureSymbol(sym).
  • For a stream of ticks use OnSymbolTick instead of polling.
  • Errors are exceptions: rejects with MrpcError / the gRPC error.

docs.title: 1) Price and spread
docs.text:
import { MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

const req = new MarketInfoPb.QuoteRequest();
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
const q = await account.quote(req);
console.log(`bid ${q.getBid()} ask ${q.getAsk()} spread ${(q.getAsk() - q.getBid()).toFixed(5)}`);

docs.title: 2) Pick the right side for an order
docs.text:
const q = await account.quote(req);
const buyPrice = q.getAsk();   // buy at ask
const sellPrice = q.getBid();  // sell at bid

docs.title: 🕯️ Quote History
docs.text:
Request: OHLC bars for a symbol, timeframe and time range (QuoteHistoryData) — the data for charts, indicators and backtests.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account.quoteHistory(request) (from @metarpc/nodemt4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Proto definition: QuoteHistory (defined in mt4-term-api-market-info.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Method: QuoteHistory(QuoteHistoryRequest) → QuoteHistoryReply
  • Low-level client (generated): MarketInfoClient.quoteHistory(request, metadata, opts, cb)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. The OHLC bars between two times, at a chosen timeframe.
  • Why you need it. Charts, moving averages, volatility, backtests.
  • Sanity check. getHistoricalQuotesList().length is the bar count; 0 means the window has no bars (weekend / gap).

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text: The raw bar feed. There is no bar-count argument — the time window decides. For "the newest N bars" use MT4Service.lastBars(sym, tf, n), which widens the window automatically.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT4Account, MarketInfoPb, TIMEFRAMES, toTimestamp } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

class MT4Account {
  // OHLC bars for a symbol/timeframe/range. Returns QuoteHistoryData; throws MrpcError on failure.
  quoteHistory(req: any /* QuoteHistoryRequest */): Promise<any /* QuoteHistoryData */>;
}

Request message:

QuoteHistoryRequest {
  string symbol    = 1;
  int32  timeframe = 2;   // ENUM_QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME ordinal (see TIMEFRAMES)
  google.protobuf.Timestamp fromtime = 3;  // range start, broker server time
  google.protobuf.Timestamp totime   = 4;  // range end,   broker server time
}

Reply: QuoteHistoryReply { oneof { QuoteHistoryData data; Error error; } }.

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Setter Type Description setSymbol(s) string The symbol. setTimeframe(n) number TIMEFRAMES['H1'] etc. — ordinals: M1=0 M5=1 M15=2 M30=3 H1=4 H4=5 D1=6 W1=7 MN1=8. setFromtime(ts) / setTotime(ts) Timestamp Range bounds, broker server time (MT4Account.serverDate(utc, shiftMin)).

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — QuoteHistoryData
docs.text:
getHistoricalQuotesList() → HistoryQuote[]:

JS accessor Type Description getTime() Timestamp Bar open time, broker server time (.getSeconds()). getTimeUtc() Timestamp The same in UTC. getOpen() / getHigh() / getLow() / getClose() number OHLC prices. getTickVolume() number Tick volume. getRealVolume() number Real volume (0 on most FX). getSpread() number Bar spread (points). getSymbol() string The symbol.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Server-time window. Bounds are broker time — convert from UTC with MT4Account.serverDate(utc, shiftMin) where shiftMin = accountSummary().getUtcServerTimeShiftMinutes().
  • Sort by getTime() if you need strict ascending order (the SDK's friendly layer sorts for you).
  • Timeframe is an ordinal, not minutes — use the TIMEFRAMES map.
  • Errors are exceptions: rejects with MrpcError / the gRPC error (this call uses a longer deadline internally).

docs.title: 1) H1 bars for a day
docs.text:
import { MT4Account, MarketInfoPb, TIMEFRAMES, toTimestamp } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

const req = new MarketInfoPb.QuoteHistoryRequest();
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
req.setTimeframe(TIMEFRAMES['H1']);                       // 4
req.setFromtime(toTimestamp(new Date(Date.now() - 864e5))); // last 24h (server time ≈ UTC here)
req.setTotime(toTimestamp(new Date()));

const data = await account.quoteHistory(req);
for (const b of data.getHistoricalQuotesList()) {
  const t = new Date(b.getTime().getSeconds() * 1000).toISOString().slice(0, 16);
  console.log(`${t}  O ${b.getOpen()} H ${b.getHigh()} L ${b.getLow()} C ${b.getClose()}`);
}

docs.title: 2) Simple moving average of closes
docs.text:
const closes = data.getHistoricalQuotesList().map((b: any) => b.getClose());
const sma = closes.slice(-20).reduce((s: number, c: number) => s + c, 0) / Math.min(20, closes.length);
console.log('SMA20:', sma.toFixed(5));

docs.title: 🕐 Server Timezone
docs.text:
Request: the broker server's UTC offset (ServerTimezoneData). Every MT4 timestamp is server time — this is how you convert it to real UTC.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account.serverTimezone(request?) (from @metarpc/nodemt4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.ServerTimezone
  • Proto definition: ServerTimezone (defined in mt4-term-api-server-timezone.proto)

docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.ServerTimezone
  • Method: ServerTimezone(ServerTimezoneRequest) → ServerTimezoneReply
  • Low-level client (generated): ServerTimezoneClient.serverTimezone(request, metadata, opts, cb)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. The broker server's offset from UTC, in seconds.
  • Why you need it. MT4 reports every time in server time; use this offset to convert bars, orders and account times to/from UTC.
  • Sanity check. getUtcOffsetSeconds() is typically a multiple of 1800 (± a few hours).

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT4Account, ServerTimezonePb } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

class MT4Account {
  // The broker server's UTC offset. Returns the raw ServerTimezoneData; throws MrpcError on failure.
  serverTimezone(req?: any /* ServerTimezoneRequest */): Promise<any /* ServerTimezoneData */>;
}

Request message: ServerTimezoneRequest {} (empty — optional) · Reply: ServerTimezoneReply { oneof { ServerTimezoneData data; Error error; } }.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — ServerTimezoneData
docs.text: JS accessor Type Description getUtcOffsetSeconds() number Broker offset from UTC in seconds (positive = ahead of UTC). getServer() string Broker server name. getSource() number (enum) Where the offset was determined from — enum result, see below. getValidatedUtc() — Validation marker for the computed UTC.

docs.title: 🔢 Enum field (returned value)
docs.text: getSource() returns a number whose meaning is a SERVER_TIMEZONE_SOURCE constant on ServerTimezonePb. Compare against the full constant, e.g. tz.getSource() === ServerTimezonePb.SERVER_TIMEZONE_SOURCE.SERVER_TIMEZONE_SOURCE_LIVE.

docs.title: getSource() → SERVER_TIMEZONE_SOURCE
docs.text:
enum SERVER_TIMEZONE_SOURCE {
  SERVER_TIMEZONE_SOURCE_UNKNOWN        = 0;  // not determined
  SERVER_TIMEZONE_SOURCE_LIVE           = 1;  // measured from the live server clock
  SERVER_TIMEZONE_SOURCE_LAST_VALIDATED = 2;  // last validated/cached value
}

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Two sources of the same truth. accountSummary().getUtcServerTimeShiftMinutes() gives the offset in minutes; serverTimezone() gives it in seconds with the server name.
  • Convert a server time to UTC: utcMs = serverMs - getUtcOffsetSeconds() * 1000.
  • Convert a UTC time to server: MT4Account.serverDate(utcDate, getUtcOffsetSeconds() / 60).
  • Errors are exceptions: rejects with MrpcError / the gRPC error.

docs.title: 1) Read the offset
docs.text:
const tz = await account.serverTimezone();
console.log(`${tz.getServer()}  UTC offset ${(tz.getUtcOffsetSeconds() / 3600).toFixed(1)} h`);

docs.title: 2) Build a server-time window for QuoteHistory / OrdersHistory
docs.text:
import { MT4Account } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

const offsetMin = (await account.serverTimezone()).getUtcOffsetSeconds() / 60;
const fromServer = MT4Account.serverDate(new Date(Date.now() - 7 * 864e5), offsetMin);
const toServer   = MT4Account.serverDate(new Date(), offsetMin);
// pass fromServer / toServer to quoteHistory or ordersHistory

  • Friendly layer: MT4Service.getServerTimezone() → typed ServerTimezone (offset in minutes too).

docs.title: 📐 Symbol Params (Many)
docs.text:
Request: the full contract specification of one symbol — or all symbols (SymbolParamsManyData): digits, point, lot limits, swaps, margin, trade modes and more.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account.symbolParamsMany(request?, timeoutMs?) (from @metarpc/nodemt4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Proto definition: SymbolParamsMany (defined in mt4-term-api-account-helper.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Method: SymbolParamsMany(SymbolParamsManyRequest) → SymbolParamsManyReply
  • Low-level client (generated): AccountHelperClient.symbolParamsMany(request, metadata, opts, cb)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. The trading rules of a symbol: price precision, min/max/step lot, swap, margin, stops level.
  • Why you need it. Validate and round a volume, respect the minimum stop distance, compute pip size, pre-trade checks.
  • Sanity check. getSymbolInfosList().length ≥ 1; set a name to get just one symbol.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT4Account, AccountHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

class MT4Account {
  // Contract spec of one (set a name) or all symbols. Returns SymbolParamsManyData; throws MrpcError on failure.
  symbolParamsMany(req?: any /* SymbolParamsManyRequest */, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<any /* SymbolParamsManyData */>;
}

Request message: SymbolParamsManyRequest { string symbol_name = 1; } (omit the name for every symbol) · Reply: SymbolParamsManyReply { oneof { SymbolParamsManyData data; Error error; } }.

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Setter Type Description setSymbolName(s) string (optional) One symbol; omit to return all (heavier — pass a larger timeoutMs, e.g. 60000).

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — SymbolParamsManyData
docs.text:
getSymbolInfosList() → SymbolParamsManyInfo[]. Key fields:

JS accessor Type Description getSymbolname() string Symbol. getSymdescription() string Long description. getDigits() number Price decimal places. getPoint() number Point size (pip = point × 10 on 3/5-digit symbols). getTradecontractsize() number Contract size (units per lot). getVolumemin() / getVolumemax() / getVolumestep() number Lot limits and step. getVolumelimit() number Max total volume per symbol. getTradestopslevel() number Min SL/TP distance from price (points). getTradefreezelevel() number Freeze distance (points). getTradetickvalue() / getTradeticksize() number Tick value / tick size (sizing). getSwaplong() / getSwapshort() / getSwapmode() number Swap rates and mode. getCurrencybase() / getCurrencyprofit() / getCurrencymargin() string Base / profit / margin currencies. getTrademode() / getTradeexemode() / getTradecalcmode() number (enum) Trade / execution / calc modes — these three return enum values, see Enum fields below. getMargininitial() / getMarginmaintenance() number Initial / maintenance margin. getIsSelected() / getVisible() boolean In Market Watch / visible. getBid() number Stale snapshot bid — price from Quote instead. getTime() Timestamp Snapshot time. getPath() string Market Watch folder path.

docs.title: 🔢 Enum fields (returned values)
docs.text: Three SymbolParamsManyInfo fields are enum results — the getter returns a number whose meaning is a constant on AccountHelperPb. They are read-only descriptors of the symbol (not request selectors). Compare against the full constant, e.g. info.getTrademode() === AccountHelperPb.SP_ENUM_SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE.SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE_FULL.

docs.title: getTrademode() → SP_ENUM_SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE
docs.text:

  SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE_DISABLED  = 0;  // trading disabled for this symbol
  SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE_LONGONLY  = 1;  // only long positions
  SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE_SHORTONLY = 2;  // only short positions
  SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE_CLOSEONLY = 3;  // only position closing
  SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE_FULL      = 4;  // no trading limitations
}

docs.title: getTradeexemode() → SP_ENUM_SYMBOL_TRADE_EXECUTION
docs.text:
enum SP_ENUM_SYMBOL_TRADE_EXECUTION {
  SYMBOL_TRADE_EXECUTION_REQUEST  = 0;  // execution by request
  SYMBOL_TRADE_EXECUTION_INSTANT  = 1;  // instant execution
  SYMBOL_TRADE_EXECUTION_MARKET   = 2;  // market execution
  SYMBOL_TRADE_EXECUTION_EXCHANGE = 3;  // exchange execution

docs.title: getTradecalcmode() → SP_ENUM_TRADE_CALC_MODE
docs.text:
enum SP_ENUM_TRADE_CALC_MODE {
  SYMBOL_TRADE_MARGINE_CALC_MODE_FOREX   = 0;  // Forex margin calculation
  SYMBOL_TRADE_MARGINE_CALC_MODE_FUTURES = 1;  // Futures margin calculation
  SYMBOL_TRADE_MARGINE_CALC_MODE_CFD     = 2;  // CFD margin calculation
}

💡 Enum usage note: the generated enums are namespace objects on AccountHelperPb. getSwapmode() is not a protobuf enum here — it comes back as a plain number swap-mode code.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Round volumes to getVolumestep() and clamp to [getVolumemin(), getVolumemax()] before sending an order.
  • Pip size = getPoint() * (digits === 3 || digits === 5 ? 10 : 1).
  • All-symbols is a big payload — pass timeoutMs = 60000 and cache it.
  • Errors are exceptions: rejects with MrpcError / the gRPC error.

docs.title: 1) One symbol's spec
docs.text:
import { MT4Account, AccountHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

const req = new AccountHelperPb.SymbolParamsManyRequest();
req.setSymbolName('EURUSD');
const info = (await account.symbolParamsMany(req)).getSymbolInfosList()[0];
console.log(`digits ${info.getDigits()}  point ${info.getPoint()}  minLot ${info.getVolumemin()}  step ${info.getVolumestep()}`);

docs.title: 2) Round a volume to the symbol's step
docs.text:
function roundVolume(info: any, lots: number): number {
  const step = info.getVolumestep() || 0.01;
  const v = Math.round(lots / step) * step;
  return Math.min(Math.max(v, info.getVolumemin()), info.getVolumemax());
}

docs.title: 3) All symbols (cached)
docs.text:
const all = await account.symbolParamsMany(new AccountHelperPb.SymbolParamsManyRequest(), 60000);
console.log('symbols with specs:', all.getSymbolInfosList().length);

docs.text:
• TickValueWithSize — just tick value / size / contract size for sizing.
  • Symbols — the plain name list.
  • Friendly layer: MT4Service.symbolParams(sym) / symbolParamsAll() → typed SymbolParams.

docs.title: ➕ Symbol Select
docs.text:
Request: add or remove a symbol in Market Watch (SymbolSelectData). A symbol must be selected before it streams quotes.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account.symbolSelect(request) (from @metarpc/nodemt4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Proto definition: SymbolSelect (defined in mt4-term-api-market-info.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Method: SymbolSelect(SymbolSelectRequest) → SymbolSelectReply
  • Low-level client (generated): MarketInfoClient.symbolSelect(request, metadata, opts, cb)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. Toggles a symbol's presence in Market Watch.
  • Why you need it. A symbol that isn't selected reports bid=ask=0 and won't appear in tick streams. Select it first.
  • Sanity check. getSuccess() is true when the toggle took effect.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT4Account, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

class MT4Account {
  // Add (select=true) or remove a symbol from Market Watch. Returns SymbolSelectData; throws MrpcError on failure.
  symbolSelect(req: any /* SymbolSelectRequest */): Promise<any /* SymbolSelectData */>;
}

Request message:

SymbolSelectRequest {
  string symbol = 1;   // the symbol
  bool   select = 2;   // true = add, false = remove
}

Reply: SymbolSelectReply { oneof { SymbolSelectData data; Error error; } }.

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Setter Type Description setSymbol(s) string The symbol to toggle. setSelect(b) boolean true add, false remove.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — SymbolSelectData
docs.text: JS accessor Type Description getSuccess() boolean Whether the operation succeeded.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Idempotent — selecting an already-selected symbol is fine.
  • Then wait for a quote. Right after selecting, poll Quote until bid>0 && ask>0, or use MT4Service.ensureSymbol(sym) which does exactly that.
  • Errors are exceptions: rejects with MrpcError / the gRPC error.

docs.title: 1) Select a symbol
docs.text:
import { MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

const req = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolSelectRequest();
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
req.setSelect(true);
const ok = await account.symbolSelect(req);
console.log('selected:', ok.getSuccess());

docs.title: 2) Select, then wait for a live quote
docs.text:
const sel = new MarketInfoPb.SymbolSelectRequest();
sel.setSymbol('GBPUSD'); sel.setSelect(true);
await account.symbolSelect(sel);

const q = new MarketInfoPb.QuoteRequest(); q.setSymbol('GBPUSD');
let tick;
for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
  tick = await account.quote(q);
  if (tick.getBid() > 0 && tick.getAsk() > 0) break;
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500));
}
console.log('GBPUSD bid', tick.getBid());

docs.text:
• Quote — read the price once selected.
  • OnSymbolTick — stream ticks of selected symbols.
  • Friendly layer: MT4Service.symbolSelect(sym, select) → boolean; ensureSymbol(sym).

docs.title: MT4Account · Symbols & Quotes — Overview
docs.text:
The market-data surface: the broker's symbol list, Market Watch management, contract specifications, live quotes, OHLC history and the server timezone. Use this page to pick the right read.

These methods are read-only. symbols, symbolSelect, quote, quoteMany, quoteHistory live on mt4_term_api.MarketInfo; symbolParamsMany, tickValueWithSize on mt4_term_api.AccountHelper; serverTimezone on mt4_term_api.ServerTimezone. Each resolves with the raw *Data (read fields with getXxx()), or rejects with MrpcError.

docs.title: 📁 What lives here
docs.text:
• Symbols — every symbol name the broker exposes.
  • SymbolSelect — add / remove a symbol in Market Watch (needed before it streams quotes).
  • SymbolParamsMany — full contract spec of one or all symbols (digits, point, lot limits, swaps, margin, …).
  • TickValueWithSize — tick value / tick size / contract size for several symbols (position sizing).
  • Quote — the latest tick (bid/ask) of one symbol.
  • QuoteMany — the latest ticks of several symbols in one call.
  • QuoteHistory — OHLC bars for a symbol / timeframe / range.
  • ServerTimezone — the broker server's UTC offset.

docs.title: 🧭 Plain English
docs.text:
• Need a price now? → quote (one symbol) or quoteMany (several).
  • Need the contract rules (digits, min lot, swap)? → symbolParamsMany.
  • Sizing a position? → tickValueWithSize.
  • Charting / backtest bars? → quoteHistory.
  • A symbol reports bid=ask=0? → it isn't in Market Watch yet; call symbolSelect(sym, true) and wait a moment.

docs.title: Quick choose
docs.text: If you need… Use Returns All symbol names symbols SymbolsData Add/remove a symbol in Market Watch symbolSelect SymbolSelectData Contract spec (one or all) symbolParamsMany SymbolParamsManyData Tick value / size for sizing tickValueWithSize TickValueWithSizeData Latest bid/ask (one) quote QuoteData Latest bid/ask (many) quoteMany QuoteManyData OHLC bars quoteHistory QuoteHistoryData Broker UTC offset serverTimezone ServerTimezoneData

docs.title: ❌ Cross-refs & gotchas
docs.text:
• Select before you stream. A freshly-referenced symbol can report bid=ask=0 for a few seconds. symbolSelect(sym, true) then poll quote — or use MT4Service.ensureSymbol(sym).
  • SymbolParams.bid is stale. The spec's bid is a snapshot; always price from quote / the tick stream.
  • History is server time. quoteHistory bounds are broker server time; convert from UTC with MT4Account.serverDate(utc, shiftMin). For "the newest N bars" use MT4Service.lastBars(sym, tf, n).
  • Timeframes are enum ordinals, not minute counts: M1=0 M5=1 M15=2 M30=3 H1=4 H4=5 D1=6 W1=7 MN1=8 (TIMEFRAMES).

docs.title: 🟢 Minimal snippets
docs.text:
// Latest price of one symbol
import { MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';
const q = new MarketInfoPb.QuoteRequest(); q.setSymbol('EURUSD');
const tick = await account.quote(q);
console.log('bid', tick.getBid(), 'ask', tick.getAsk());

// Contract spec of one symbol
import { AccountHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';
const r = new AccountHelperPb.SymbolParamsManyRequest(); r.setSymbolName('EURUSD');
const info = (await account.symbolParamsMany(r)).getSymbolInfosList()[0];
console.log('digits', info.getDigits(), 'point', info.getPoint(), 'minLot', info.getVolumemin());

// Newest 100 H1 bars (friendly layer handles the server-time window)
const bars = await svc.lastBars('EURUSD', 'H1', 100);

  • Friendly layer: MT4Service.quote() / symbolParams() / quoteHistory() → typed Quote / SymbolParams / Bar[].

docs.title: 🧮 Tick Value With Size
docs.text:
Request: tick value, tick size and contract size for several symbols in one call (TickValueWithSizeData) — the inputs for position sizing.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account.tickValueWithSize(request) (from @metarpc/nodemt4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Proto definition: TickValueWithSize (defined in mt4-term-api-account-helper.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Method: TickValueWithSize(TickValueWithSizeRequest) → TickValueWithSizeReply
  • Low-level client (generated): AccountHelperClient.tickValueWithSize(request, metadata, opts, cb)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. For each symbol: the money value of one tick, the tick size, and the contract size.
  • Why you need it. Convert a stop distance in pips into a money risk → compute a lot size.
  • Sanity check. getTradetickvalue() > 0 && getTradeticksize() > 0.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT4Account, AccountHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

class MT4Account {
  // Tick value / size / contract size for many symbols. Returns TickValueWithSizeData; throws MrpcError on failure.
  tickValueWithSize(req: any /* TickValueWithSizeRequest */): Promise<any /* TickValueWithSizeData */>;
}

Request message: TickValueWithSizeRequest { repeated string symbol_names = 1; } · Reply: TickValueWithSizeReply { oneof { TickValueWithSizeData data; Error error; } }.

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Setter Type Description setSymbolNamesList(arr) string[] The symbols to size.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — TickValueWithSizeData
docs.text:
getInfosList() → SymbolTickValueWithSizeInfo[]:

JS accessor Type Description getSymbolname() string Symbol. getTradetickvalue() number Money value of one tick (deposit currency). getTradeticksize() number Minimum price change. getTradecontractsize() number Units per lot.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Value per pip per lot = (pipSize / tickSize) * tickValue, where pipSize = point * (digits===3||5 ? 10 : 1).
  • Lot for a risk = riskMoney / (stopPips * valuePerPipPerLot) — then round to the volume step. The friendly MT4Sugar.calculatePositionSize() does this.
  • Errors are exceptions: rejects with MrpcError / the gRPC error.

docs.title: 1) Tick value of a basket
docs.text:
import { MT4Account, AccountHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

const req = new AccountHelperPb.TickValueWithSizeRequest();
req.setSymbolNamesList(['EURUSD', 'XAUUSD']);
for (const i of (await account.tickValueWithSize(req)).getInfosList()) {
  console.log(`${i.getSymbolname()}  tickValue ${i.getTradetickvalue()}  tickSize ${i.getTradeticksize()}  contract ${i.getTradecontractsize()}`);
}

docs.title: 2) Risk-based lot size
docs.text:
const [info] = (await account.tickValueWithSize(req)).getInfosList();
const digits = 5, point = 0.00001;
const pip = point * (digits === 3 || digits === 5 ? 10 : 1);
const valuePerPipPerLot = (pip / info.getTradeticksize()) * info.getTradetickvalue();
const riskMoney = 100, stopPips = 20;
const lots = riskMoney / (stopPips * valuePerPipPerLot);
console.log('lots:', lots.toFixed(2));

docs.text:

  • Friendly layer: MT4Service.tickValueWithSize(symbols); MT4Sugar.calculatePositionSize().

docs.title: 🔁 Order Close By
docs.text:
Request: close an order by an opposite order on the same symbol (OrderCloseByData) — net a buy against a sell in one operation.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account.orderCloseBy(request) (from @metarpc/nodemt4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.TradingHelper
  • Proto definition: OrderCloseBy (defined in mt4-term-api-trading-helper.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.TradingHelper
  • Method: OrderCloseBy(OrderCloseByRequest) → OrderCloseByReply
  • Low-level client (generated): TradingHelperClient.orderCloseBy(request, metadata, opts, cb)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. Closes one order using an opposite one on the same symbol (a buy closed by a sell, or vice-versa).
  • Why you need it. Net hedged positions with no extra spread cost, instead of closing both separately.
  • Sanity check. Returns the resulting getClosePrice() and getProfit().

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT4Account, TradingHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

class MT4Account {
  // Close an order by an opposite one on the same symbol. Returns OrderCloseByData; rejects with MrpcError / TradeOutcomeUnknownError.
  orderCloseBy(req: any /* OrderCloseByRequest */): Promise<any /* OrderCloseByData */>;
}

Request message:

OrderCloseByRequest {
  int32 ticket_to_close           = 1;  // the order being closed
  int32 opposite_ticket_closing_by = 2;  // the opposite order used to close it
}

Reply: OrderCloseByReply { oneof { OrderCloseByData data; Error error; } }.

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Setter Type Description setTicketToClose(t) number The order to close. setOppositeTicketClosingBy(t) number An opposite-direction order on the same symbol used to close it.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — OrderCloseByData
docs.text: JS accessor Type Description getClosePrice() number Price at which the close-by settled. getProfit() number Realized profit of the operation. getCloseTime() / getCloseTimeUtc() Timestamp When it settled (server / UTC).

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Same symbol, opposite direction — both tickets must be on one symbol, one buy and one sell.
  • Volumes may differ — the smaller is fully closed; the larger leaves a remainder with a new ticket.
  • Unknown outcome → TradeOutcomeUnknownError; err.operation === 'OrderCloseBy'.

docs.title: 1) Net a buy against a sell
docs.text:
import { TradingHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderCloseByRequest();
req.setTicketToClose(123456);            // the buy
req.setOppositeTicketClosingBy(123457);  // the sell on the same symbol
const res = await account.orderCloseBy(req);
console.log(`closed by @ ${res.getClosePrice()}  profit ${res.getProfit().toFixed(2)}`);

docs.title: 2) Guard with a symbol check first
docs.text:
const orders = (await account.openedOrders()).getOrderInfosList();
const a = orders.find((o: any) => o.getTicket() === 123456);
const b = orders.find((o: any) => o.getTicket() === 123457);
if (a && b && a.getSymbol() === b.getSymbol() && a.getOrderType() !== b.getOrderType()) {
  const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderCloseByRequest();
  req.setTicketToClose(a.getTicket());
  req.setOppositeTicketClosingBy(b.getTicket());
  await account.orderCloseBy(req);
}

docs.text:
• OrderCloseDelete — close/delete a single order.
  • OpenedOrders — find the two tickets.
  • Friendly layer: MT4Service.orderCloseBy(ticket, opposite).

  • Why you need it. Exit a trade, scale out, cancel a pending.

Request message:

OrderCloseDeleteRequest {
  int32  order_ticket  = 1;
  double lots          = 2;   // volume to close (full or partial); ignored for a pending delete
  double closing_price = 3;   // bid to close a buy, ask to close a sell; 0 for a pending delete
  int32  slippage      = 4;   // points
}

Reply: OrderCloseDeleteReply { oneof { OrderCloseDeleteData data; Error error; } }.

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Setter Type Description setOrderTicket(t) number The order to close / delete. setLots(v) number Volume to close (use the order's full lots to close all; a smaller value = partial). setClosingPrice(p) number Market close: bid to close a buy, ask to close a sell. Pending delete: 0. setSlippage(n) number Max slippage in points (optional).

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — OrderCloseDeleteData
🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Look up price & volume from OpenedOrders (and Quote) when you don't have them — the friendly MT4Service.orderClose({ ticket }) does this for you.
  • Partial close leaves a remaining order with a new ticket.
  • Unknown outcome → TradeOutcomeUnknownError; err.operation === 'OrderCloseDelete' — reconcile before retrying.

docs.title: 1) Close a whole buy at the bid
docs.text:
import { MT4Account, TradingHelperPb, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

// find the order
const o = (await account.openedOrders()).getOrderInfosList().find((x: any) => x.getTicket() === 123456);
const q = new MarketInfoPb.QuoteRequest(); q.setSymbol(o.getSymbol());
const bid = (await account.quote(q)).getBid();

const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderCloseDeleteRequest();
req.setOrderTicket(123456);
req.setLots(o.getLots());
req.setClosingPrice(bid);     // bid closes a buy
req.setSlippage(30);
const res = await account.orderCloseDelete(req);
console.log(res.getMode() === 0 ? 'closed' : 'deleted');

const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderCloseDeleteRequest();
req.setOrderTicket(123456);
req.setLots(o.getLots() / 2);
req.setClosingPrice(bid);
await account.orderCloseDelete(req);

docs.text:
const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderCloseDeleteRequest();
req.setOrderTicket(123456);
req.setLots(0);
req.setClosingPrice(0);       // pending delete
await account.orderCloseDelete(req);

docs.title: ✏️ Order Modify
docs.text:
Request: change an order's stop-loss / take-profit (and, for pending orders, its price / expiration) (OrderModifyData).

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account.orderModify(request) (from @metarpc/nodemt4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.TradingHelper
  • Proto definition: OrderModify (defined in mt4-term-api-trading-helper.proto)

docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.TradingHelper

  • Low-level client (generated): TradingHelperClient.orderModify(request, metadata, opts, cb)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. Updates SL/TP of any order, plus price/expiration of a pending order.
  • Why you need it. Attach or trail a stop, set a target, re-price a pending order.
  • Sanity check. getOrderWasModified() is true when the change applied.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT4Account, TradingHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

class MT4Account {
  // Change SL/TP (+ price/expiration for pending). Returns OrderModifyData; rejects with MrpcError / TradeOutcomeUnknownError.
  orderModify(req: any /* OrderModifyRequest */): Promise<any /* OrderModifyData */>;
}

Request message:

OrderModifyRequest {
  int32  order_ticket   = 1;
  double new_stop_loss  = 2;
  double new_take_profit= 3;
  double new_price      = 4;   // pending orders only
  google.protobuf.Timestamp new_expiration = 5;  // pending orders only
}

Reply: OrderModifyReply { oneof { OrderModifyData data; Error error; } }.

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text:
Setter Type Description setOrderTicket(t) number The order to modify. setNewStopLoss(p) number New SL price (pass the full value you want). setNewTakeProfit(p) number New TP price. setNewPrice(p) number Pending orders: new trigger price. setNewExpiration(ts) Timestamp Pending orders: new expiry.

Pass the full new values. MT4 modify replaces SL/TP — include the unchanged one too, or it may be cleared.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — OrderModifyData
docs.text: JS accessor Type Description getOrderWasModified() boolean Whether the modification applied.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Respect the stops level. SL/TP must be at least SymbolParams.getTradestopslevel() points from price, or the broker refuses (mqlIntCode 130).
  • Keep the other side. To change only SL, read the order first and re-send its current TP (the friendly MT4Sugar.modifyPositionSL/TP do this).
  • Unknown outcome → TradeOutcomeUnknownError; err.operation === 'OrderModify'.

docs.title: 1) Attach a stop-loss
docs.text:
import { TradingHelperPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderModifyRequest();
req.setOrderTicket(123456);
req.setNewStopLoss(1.0950);
const res = await account.orderModify(req);
console.log('modified:', res.getOrderWasModified());

docs.title: 2) Set both SL and TP
docs.text:
const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderModifyRequest();
req.setOrderTicket(123456);
req.setNewStopLoss(1.0950);
req.setNewTakeProfit(1.1100);
await account.orderModify(req);

docs.title: 3) Re-price a pending order
docs.text:
const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderModifyRequest();
req.setOrderTicket(123456);
req.setNewPrice(1.0480);
await account.orderModify(req);

docs.title: 🚀 Order Send
docs.text:
Request: open a market or pending order (OrderSendData). Sent exactly once; a broker refusal throws MrpcError, an unknown transport outcome throws TradeOutcomeUnknownError.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account.orderSend(request) (from @metarpc/nodemt4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.TradingHelper
  • Proto definition: OrderSend (defined in mt4-term-api-trading-helper.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.TradingHelper
  • Method: OrderSend(OrderSendRequest) → OrderSendReply
  • Low-level client (generated): TradingHelperClient.orderSend(request, metadata, opts, cb)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. Opens a market order (OP_BUY/OP_SELL) or places a pending order (LIMIT/STOP).
  • Why you need it. It's how trades enter the market.
  • Sanity check. Success returns a non-zero getTicket().

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT4Account, TradingHelperPb, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

class MT4Account {
  // Open a market/pending order. Returns OrderSendData; rejects with MrpcError / TradeOutcomeUnknownError.
  orderSend(req: any /* OrderSendRequest */): Promise<any /* OrderSendData */>;
}

Request message:

OrderSendRequest {
  string symbol         = 1;
  OrderSendOperationType operation_type = 2;  // 0 BUY · 1 SELL · 2 BUYLIMIT · 3 SELLLIMIT · 4 BUYSTOP · 5 SELLSTOP
  double volume         = 3;   // lots
  double price          = 4;   // required — ask for buys, bid for sells (market)
  double stoploss       = 5;
  double takeprofit     = 6;
  int32  slippage       = 7;   // points
  string comment        = 8;
  int32  magic_number   = 9;
  google.protobuf.Timestamp expiration = 10;  // pending orders
}

Reply: OrderSendReply { oneof { OrderSendData data; Error error; } }.

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Setter Type Description setSymbol(s) string Symbol. setOperationType(t) OrderSendOperationType Order type (0–5) — see Enum field below. setVolume(v) number Lots. setPrice(p) number Required. Market: ask for buys, bid for sells. Pending: the trigger price. setStoploss(p) / setTakeprofit(p) number SL / TP prices (optional). setSlippage(n) number Max slippage in points (optional). setComment(s) / setMagicNumber(n) string / number Tag the order (optional). setExpiration(ts) Timestamp Pending-order expiry (optional).

docs.title: 🔢 Enum field — setOperationType() → OrderSendOperationType
docs.text:
enum OrderSendOperationType {
  OC_OP_BUY       = 0;  // market buy
  OC_OP_SELL      = 1;  // market sell
  OC_OP_BUYLIMIT  = 2;  // pending buy limit  (price below market)
  OC_OP_SELLLIMIT = 3;  // pending sell limit (price above market)
  OC_OP_BUYSTOP   = 4;  // pending buy stop   (price above market)
  OC_OP_SELLSTOP  = 5;  // pending sell stop  (price below market)
}

💡 Enum usage note: on TradingHelperPb. Pass the full constant, e.g. req.setOperationType(TradingHelperPb.OrderSendOperationType.OC_OP_BUY). Same 0–5 numbering as OpenedOrderType in results. The friendly layers accept the string action ('BUY', 'SELL_LIMIT', …) instead.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — OrderSendData
docs.text: JS accessor Type Description getTicket() number The new order's ticket. getVolume() number Filled volume (lots). getPrice() number Execution / placement price. getOpenTime() / getOpenTimeUtc() Timestamp Open time (server / UTC).

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Price is mandatory. Read Quote first; the friendly layers fill it for market orders when omitted.
  • Refusals carry mqlIntCode (130/131/132/134/138…). err.operation === 'OrderSend'.
  • Unknown outcome → TradeOutcomeUnknownError: reconcile with openedOrders before any retry. Never blindly resend.
  • 60 s deadline internally.

docs.title: 1) Market BUY at the current ask
docs.text:
import { MT4Account, TradingHelperPb, MarketInfoPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

const q = new MarketInfoPb.QuoteRequest(); q.setSymbol('EURUSD');
const ask = (await account.quote(q)).getAsk();

const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderSendRequest();
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
req.setOperationType(TradingHelperPb.OrderSendOperationType.OC_OP_BUY);
req.setVolume(0.01);
req.setPrice(ask);
req.setSlippage(30);
req.setComment('NodeMT4');
const res = await account.orderSend(req);
console.log('ticket', res.getTicket(), 'at', res.getPrice());

docs.title: 2) Pending BUY LIMIT with SL/TP
docs.text:
const req = new TradingHelperPb.OrderSendRequest();
req.setSymbol('EURUSD');
req.setOperationType(TradingHelperPb.OrderSendOperationType.OC_OP_BUYLIMIT);
req.setVolume(0.01);
req.setPrice(1.0500);       // trigger below market
req.setStoploss(1.0450);
req.setTakeprofit(1.0600);
const res = await account.orderSend(req);

docs.title: 3) Safe error handling
docs.text:
import { TradeOutcomeUnknownError } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';
try {
  const res = await account.orderSend(req);
  console.log('opened', res.getTicket());
} catch (e) {
  if (e instanceof TradeOutcomeUnknownError) console.log('⚠️ outcome unknown — check openedOrders before retrying');
  else console.log('refused:', e.message, 'mql', e.mqlIntCode);
}

docs.text:
• OrderModify · OrderCloseDelete · OrderCloseBy.
  • Friendly layer: MT4Service.orderSend(OrderRequest); MT4Sugar.buyMarket/sellMarket/buyLimit….

docs.title: MT4Account · Trading Operations — Overview
docs.text:
Send, modify, close/delete and close-by — the four trade RPCs. On MT4 a trade is sent exactly once and never re-sent: a transport failure after the request may have reached the terminal becomes a TradeOutcomeUnknownError.

These methods live on mt4_term_api.TradingHelper. Each resolves with the raw *Data, or rejects — with an MrpcError (the broker refused) or a TradeOutcomeUnknownError (the outcome is unknown).

docs.title: 📁 What lives here
docs.text:
• OrderSend — open a market or pending order.
  • OrderModify — change SL/TP (and price/expiration for pending orders).
  • OrderCloseDelete — close a market order (fully or partially) or delete a pending one.
  • OrderCloseBy — close an order by an opposite order on the same symbol.

docs.title: 🧭 Plain English
docs.text:
• Open → orderSend with an OrderSendOperationType (OP_BUY, OP_SELL, OP_BUYLIMIT, …).
  • Adjust → orderModify (pass the full new SL/TP).
  • Close / delete → orderCloseDelete (a market close or a pending delete; getMode() tells which).
  • Net two opposite orders → orderCloseBy.

Order types (OrderSendOperationType): OC_OP_BUY (0) · OC_OP_SELL (1) · OC_OP_BUYLIMIT (2) · OC_OP_SELLLIMIT (3) · OC_OP_BUYSTOP (4) · OC_OP_SELLSTOP (5).

docs.title: ⚠️ Exactly-once & unknown outcomes
docs.text:
Every trade routes through the SDK's tradeCall, which sends it once:

  • The broker refuses → MrpcError with mqlIntCode (130 invalid stops, 131 invalid volume, 132 market closed, 134 no money, 138 requote). err.operation names the call.
  • The transport fails after the request may have reached the terminal (gRPC UNAVAILABLE / DEADLINE_EXCEEDED / UNKNOWN / INTERNAL), or MT4 answers 128 (trade timeout) → TradeOutcomeUnknownError. The trade may or may not have executed — check open orders before retrying. The SDK never re-sends.
import { TradeOutcomeUnknownError } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

try {
  await account.orderSend(req);
} catch (e) {
  if (e instanceof TradeOutcomeUnknownError) {
    // DO NOT blindly resend — reconcile with openedOrders() first
  } else {
    console.log('refused:', e.message, e.mqlIntCode);
  }
}

docs.title: Quick choose
docs.text: If you need… Use Returns Open a market / pending order orderSend OrderSendData Change SL / TP (or pending price/expiry) orderModify OrderModifyData Close a market order / delete a pending orderCloseDelete OrderCloseDeleteData Close by an opposite order orderCloseBy OrderCloseByData

docs.title: ❌ Gotchas
docs.text:
• Market orders need a price. MT4's orderSend requires a request price — read Quote (ask for buys, bid for sells) first. The friendly layers fill it for you.
  • Slippage is in points.
  • Closing needs the price too — bid to close a buy, ask to close a sell. orderCloseDelete with a pending ticket just deletes it.
  • Longer deadline. Trade calls use a 60 s deadline internally.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Validate/size first: SymbolParamsMany · TickValueWithSize.
  • Friendly layer: MT4Service.orderSend/orderModify/orderClose/orderCloseBy; one-liners in MT4Sugar.

Back to: MT4Account — Master Overview

docs.title: 🔌 On Connect State
docs.text:
Stream: terminal connection-state events — connected / alive / API-alive, with the server and account. Pause a strategy while the terminal is offline.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account.onConnectState(request?, onData, onError?) (from @metarpc/nodemt4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.Connection
  • Proto definition: OnConnectState (defined in mt4-term-api-connection.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.Connection
  • Method: OnConnectState(OnConnectStateRequest) → stream OnConnectStateReply
  • Low-level client (generated): ConnectionClient.onConnectState(request, metadata) (server stream)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. A push stream of the terminal's connection health.
  • Why you need it. Gate trading on "is the terminal actually connected and alive?"; log disconnects/reconnects.
  • Sanity check. getIsConnected() && getIsAlive() means it's ready.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT4Account, ConnectionPb, Subscription } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

class MT4Account {
  // Terminal connection-state stream. Returns a Subscription; unsubscribe() to stop.
  onConnectState(req?: any /* OnConnectStateRequest */, onData?: (data: any) => void, onError?: (e: any) => void): Subscription;
}

Request message: OnConnectStateRequest { repeated string terminal_ids = 1; } (optional — defaults to the current terminal) Reply (streamed): OnConnectStateReply { oneof { ConnectStateData data; Error error; } }.

docs.title: ⬆️ Payload — ConnectStateData
docs.text: JS accessor Type Description getIsConnected() boolean Terminal is connected to the broker. getIsAlive() boolean Terminal process is alive. getApiIsAlive() boolean The MRPC API bridge is alive. getState() number / string Connection-state code. getServer() string Broker server name. getAccount() number Account login. getId() string Terminal session id (GUID). getTimestamp() Timestamp Event time. getErrorMessage() string Reason, when not connected.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Gate your strategy — only send orders while getIsConnected() && getIsAlive().
  • Reconnect on loss — on a disconnect you may also want account.reconnect() (after a TERMINAL_INSTANCE_NOT_FOUND).
  • Re-subscribe on onError; unsubscribe() when done.

docs.title: 1) Watch connection health
docs.text:
import { MT4Account, ConnectionPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

const sub = account.onConnectState(new ConnectionPb.OnConnectStateRequest(), (data) => {
  console.log(`connected ${data.getIsConnected()}  alive ${data.getIsAlive()}  server ${data.getServer()}`);
  if (!data.getIsConnected()) console.log('⚠️ offline:', data.getErrorMessage());
}, (e) => console.log('state stream error:', e.message || e));

// later: sub.unsubscribe();

docs.title: 2) A "ready to trade" gate
docs.text:
let ready = false;
account.onConnectState(new ConnectionPb.OnConnectStateRequest(), (d) => {
  ready = d.getIsConnected() && d.getIsAlive();
});
// elsewhere: if (ready) await sugar.buyMarket('EURUSD', 0.01);

docs.title: 📚 See Also
docs.text:
• AccountSummary — a one-shot "is the connection alive?" check.
  • Connection lifecycle: connect / reconnect / checkConnect on MT4Account.
  • Friendly layer: MT4Service.subscribeConnectState(cb).

docs.title: 💰 On Opened Orders Profit
docs.text:
Stream: a periodic snapshot of all open orders with live floating profit, plus an account snapshot that includes margin — the reliable source of margin on MT4.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account.onOpenedOrdersProfit(request, onData, onError?) (from @metarpc/nodemt4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.SubscriptionService
  • Proto definition: OnOpenedOrdersProfit (defined in mt4-term-api-subscriptions.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.SubscriptionService
  • Method: OnOpenedOrdersProfit(OnOpenedOrdersProfitRequest) → stream OnOpenedOrdersProfitReply
  • Low-level client (generated): SubscriptionServiceClient.onOpenedOrdersProfit(request, metadata) (server stream)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. On a timer, the open orders with their current profit, plus the account's balance / equity / margin / free margin / margin level.
  • Why you need it. A live P/L dashboard — and the only dependable way to read margin on MT4 (AccountSummary returns 0).
  • Sanity check. First event arrives after ~timerPeriodMs.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT4Account, SubscriptionsPb, Subscription } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

class MT4Account {
  // Periodic open-orders-with-profit + account snapshot. Returns a Subscription; unsubscribe() to stop.
  onOpenedOrdersProfit(req: any /* OnOpenedOrdersProfitRequest */, onData: (data: any) => void, onError?: (e: any) => void): Subscription;
}

Request message: OnOpenedOrdersProfitRequest { int32 timer_period_milliseconds = 1; } Reply (streamed): OnOpenedOrdersProfitReply { oneof { OnOpenedOrdersProfitData data; Error error; } }.

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Setter Type Description setTimerPeriodMilliseconds(ms) number How often to emit a snapshot (e.g. 1000).

docs.title: ⬆️ Payload — OnOpenedOrdersProfitData
docs.text:
JS accessor Description getOpenedOrdersWithProfitUpdatedList() Open orders, each with getTicket(), getSymbol(), getType(), getLots(), getOpenPrice(), getOrderProfit(), getStopLoss(), getTakeProfit(), getSwap(), getCommission(), getMagicNumber(). getAccountInfo() getBalance(), getEquity(), getMargin(), getFreeMargin(), getProfit(), getMarginLevel().

Each order's getType() is an enum result — SubscriptionsPb.SUB_ORDER_OPERATION_TYPE (SUB_OP_BUY 0 … SUB_OP_SELLSTOP 5), the same 0–5 numbering as trading. See the OnTrade enum table.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Margin lives here. This is where MT4Sugar.getMargin() / getFreeMargin() / getMarginLevel() read one snapshot.
  • Pick a sane period — 1000 ms is a good default; too small floods your callback.
  • Re-subscribe on onError; unsubscribe() when done.

docs.title: 1) One live account snapshot (margin)
docs.text:
import { MT4Account, SubscriptionsPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

const req = new SubscriptionsPb.OnOpenedOrdersProfitRequest();
req.setTimerPeriodMilliseconds(1000);

const sub = account.onOpenedOrdersProfit(req, (data) => {
  const a = data.getAccountInfo();
  if (a) console.log(`equity ${a.getEquity().toFixed(2)}  margin ${a.getMargin().toFixed(2)}  free ${a.getFreeMargin().toFixed(2)}`);
  sub.unsubscribe();   // just one snapshot
}, (e) => console.log('error:', e.message || e));

docs.title: 2) Live P/L of each open order
docs.text:
const sub = account.onOpenedOrdersProfit(req, (data) => {
  for (const o of data.getOpenedOrdersWithProfitUpdatedList()) {
    console.log(`#${o.getTicket()} ${o.getSymbol()} P/L ${o.getOrderProfit().toFixed(2)}`);
  }
});
// later: sub.unsubscribe();

docs.text:
• AccountSummary — note its margin fields are 0 on MT4.
  • OnTrade — event-driven (not timer-based) changes.
  • Friendly layer: MT4Service.subscribeOpenedOrdersProfit(ms, cb); MT4Sugar.getMargin().

  • Why you need it. Cheap change-detection without pulling full order detail.

docs.text:

class MT4Account {
  // Periodic ticket snapshot. Returns a Subscription; unsubscribe() to stop.
  onOpenedOrdersTickets(req: any /* OnOpenedOrdersTicketsRequest */, onData: (data: any) => void, onError?: (e: any) => void): Subscription;

• Diff between snapshots to detect opens/closes — cheaper than full OpenedOrders.
  • Fetch detail on change — when a ticket appears/disappears, pull its full info once.

docs.title: 1) Print one snapshot
docs.text:
import { MT4Account, SubscriptionsPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

const req = new SubscriptionsPb.OnOpenedOrdersTicketsRequest();
req.setPullIntervalMilliseconds(1000);

const sub = account.onOpenedOrdersTickets(req, (data) => {
  console.log('positions:', data.getPositionTicketsList(), 'pending:', data.getPendingOrderTicketsList());
  sub.unsubscribe();
}, (e) => console.log('error:', e.message || e));

docs.title: 2) React to opens / closes
docs.text:
let prev = new Set<number>();
const sub = account.onOpenedOrdersTickets(req, (data) => {
  const now = new Set<number>([...data.getPositionTicketsList(), ...data.getPendingOrderTicketsList()]);
  for (const t of now) if (!prev.has(t)) console.log('opened #', t);
  for (const t of prev) if (!now.has(t)) console.log('closed #', t);
  prev = now;
});

docs.title: 📡 On Symbol Tick
docs.text:
Stream: live ticks for one or more symbols. The callback fires with each reply's raw *Data; read the tick via getSymbolTick().

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. A push stream of ticks for the symbols you subscribe.
  • Why you need it. Live prices without polling Quote.
  • Sanity check. Select symbols first (Market Watch) or no ticks arrive.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT4Account, SubscriptionsPb, Subscription } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

class MT4Account {
  // Live tick stream. Returns a Subscription; call unsubscribe() to stop.
  onSymbolTick(req: any /* OnSymbolTickRequest */, onData: (data: any) => void, onError?: (e: any) => void): Subscription;
}

Request message: OnSymbolTickRequest { repeated string symbol_names = 1; } Reply (streamed): OnSymbolTickReply { oneof { OnSymbolTickData data; Error error; } }.

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text: Setter Type Description setSymbolNamesList(arr) string[] Symbols to stream (must be in Market Watch).

docs.title: ⬆️ Payload — OnSymbolTickData
docs.text:
getSymbolTick() → OnSymbolMqlTickInfo:

JS accessor Type Description getSymbol() string The symbol. getBid() / getAsk() number Bid / ask. getLast() number Last price. getVolume() number Tick volume. getTime() Timestamp Tick time, broker server time. getTimeMsc() number Tick time, milliseconds (server). getTimeUtc() / getTimeMscUtc() Timestamp / number The same in UTC.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Select first — SymbolSelect each symbol, or no ticks come.
  • Re-subscribe on onError (transport error / unexpected end); a cancel via unsubscribe() is not an error.
  • Keep callbacks fast — offload heavy work; ticks can be frequent.

docs.title: 1) Stream two symbols for 5 seconds
docs.text:
import { MT4Account, SubscriptionsPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

const req = new SubscriptionsPb.OnSymbolTickRequest();
req.setSymbolNamesList(['EURUSD', 'GBPUSD']);

const sub = account.onSymbolTick(req, (data) => {
  const t = data.getSymbolTick();
  if (t) console.log(`${t.getSymbol()} bid ${t.getBid()} ask ${t.getAsk()}`);
}, (e) => console.log('stream error:', e.message || e));

setTimeout(() => sub.unsubscribe(), 5000);

docs.title: 2) Track the latest bid per symbol
docs.text:
const latest: Record<string, number> = {};
const sub = account.onSymbolTick(req, (data) => {
  const t = data.getSymbolTick();
  if (t) latest[t.getSymbol()] = t.getBid();
});

docs.title: 🔔 On Trade
docs.text:
Stream: trade events — fills, modifications and closes. Each reply carries an event type, the affected orders (new / updated / removed / history), and an account snapshot.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account.onTrade(request, onData, onError?) (from @metarpc/nodemt4)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.SubscriptionService
  • Proto definition: OnTrade (defined in mt4-term-api-subscriptions.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.SubscriptionService
  • Method: OnTrade(OnTradeRequest) → stream OnTradeReply
  • Low-level client (generated): SubscriptionServiceClient.onTrade(request, metadata) (server stream)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. A push stream fired whenever the account's orders change.
  • Why you need it. React to fills and closes immediately, keep a live order book, log activity.
  • Sanity check. getType() is the event type; getEventData() holds the changed orders.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
import { MT4Account, SubscriptionsPb, Subscription } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

class MT4Account {
  // Trade-event stream. Returns a Subscription; call unsubscribe() to stop.
  onTrade(req: any /* OnTradeRequest */, onData: (data: any) => void, onError?: (e: any) => void): Subscription;
}

Request message: OnTradeRequest {} (empty) Reply (streamed): OnTradeReply { oneof { OnTradeData data; Error error; } }.

docs.title: ⬆️ Payload — OnTradeData
docs.text:
JS accessor Type Description getType() number (enum) Event group — MT4_SUB_ENUM_EVENT_GROUP_TYPE, see Enum fields below. (What changed is in the four getEventData() lists, not in this field.) getEventData() message The changed orders — see below. getAccountInfo() message Account snapshot (balance / equity / margin / freeMargin / profit / marginLevel).

getEventData() exposes:

Accessor Description getNewOrdersList() Newly opened orders. getUpdatedOrdersList() Modified orders — each has getPrevious() / getCurrent(). getRemovedOrdersList() Closed / deleted orders. getNewHistoryOrdersList() Orders that moved to history.

Each order object (OnTradeOrderInfo) exposes the usual fields (getTicket(), getSymbol(), getType(), getLots(), getOpenPrice(), getOrderProfit(), getStopLoss(), getTakeProfit(), …). Its getType() is an enum result — SUB_ORDER_OPERATION_TYPE, see below.

docs.title: 🔢 Enum fields (returned values)
docs.text: Two getters in this stream return numbers whose meaning is a constant on SubscriptionsPb.

docs.title: OnTradeData.getType() → MT4_SUB_ENUM_EVENT_GROUP_TYPE
docs.text:
enum MT4_SUB_ENUM_EVENT_GROUP_TYPE {
  ORDERPROFIT = 0;  // periodic profit/price refresh of open orders
  ORDERUPDATE = 1;  // an order was opened / modified / closed
}

docs.title: each order's getType() → SUB_ORDER_OPERATION_TYPE
docs.text:
enum SUB_ORDER_OPERATION_TYPE {
  SUB_OP_BUY       = 0;  // market buy
  SUB_OP_SELL      = 1;  // market sell
  SUB_OP_BUYLIMIT  = 2;  // pending buy limit
  SUB_OP_SELLLIMIT = 3;  // pending sell limit
  SUB_OP_BUYSTOP   = 4;  // pending buy stop
  SUB_OP_SELLSTOP  = 5;  // pending sell stop
}

💡 Enum usage note: same 0–5 numbering as the trading OrderSendOperationType and OpenedOrderType — a buy is 0, a sell is 1, pendings are 2–5. Compare against the full constant, e.g. o.getType() === SubscriptionsPb.SUB_ORDER_OPERATION_TYPE.SUB_OP_BUY.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• One stream covers the account — no per-symbol subscription needed.
  • getAccountInfo() carries margin here too (useful on MT4).
  • Re-subscribe on onError; unsubscribe() is a clean cancel.

docs.title: 1) Log fills and closes
docs.text:
import { MT4Account, SubscriptionsPb } from '@metarpc/nodemt4';

const sub = account.onTrade(new SubscriptionsPb.OnTradeRequest(), (data) => {
  const ev = data.getEventData();
  if (ev) {
    for (const o of ev.getNewOrdersList())     console.log('OPEN  #', o.getTicket(), o.getSymbol());
    for (const o of ev.getRemovedOrdersList()) console.log('CLOSE #', o.getTicket(), 'P/L', o.getOrderProfit());
  }
}, (e) => console.log('trade stream error:', e.message || e));

// later: sub.unsubscribe();

docs.title: 2) Keep a running equity read
docs.text:
const sub = account.onTrade(new SubscriptionsPb.OnTradeRequest(), (data) => {
  const a = data.getAccountInfo();
  if (a) console.log(`equity ${a.getEquity().toFixed(2)} margin ${a.getMargin().toFixed(2)}`);
});
